questions.question: Who are the two sisters in the allegory of Ezekiel 23?
options: Leah of Israel and her sister Rachel of Judah
Hagar of Egypt and her mistress Sarah of Canaan
Naomi of Bethlehem and her daughter Ruth of Moab

questions.question: What do the two sisters represent?
options: Two faithful prophets who were sent to warn the rebellious people
Two great cities that lived together at peace under the rule of one king
Samaria and Jerusalem, unfaithful through idolatry and foreign alliances
Two wholly faithful cities that never once turned away from the LORD
questions.answer: Samaria and Jerusalem, unfaithful through idolatry and foreign alliances
